name: Unwanted Hair
metaTitle: Unwanted Hair Treatment in Pune by MD Dermatologist | Skin Essence
metaDescription: Facial and body hair that keeps returning, ingrown hairs and PCOS-related growth: laser hair reduction in Kalyani Nagar, Pune. Book a consultation.
intro: Unwanted facial and body hair is a routine concern for women and increasingly for men, and the usual answers of waxing, threading and shaving bring ingrown hairs, razor bumps, darkened skin and a lifetime of appointments.

When hair growth is excessive, sudden or on the face in women, it can signal a hormonal condition such as PCOS, which should be checked before treatment. For most patients, laser hair reduction offers a long-term solution.
causes: Normal genetic hair growth patterns, which vary widely between families
PCOS and other hormonal imbalances causing coarse facial hair in women
Certain medicines, including some steroids and hormonal treatments
Thyroid and adrenal conditions in a small number of cases
Repeated waxing and shaving, which do not increase hair but cause ingrown hairs and darkening

faqs.q: Does laser hair removal work on Indian skin?
faqs.a: Yes. Diode and Nd:YAG lasers are designed for darker skin tones. Settings are chosen by the dermatologist for your skin type to reduce the risk of burns or pigmentation.

faqs.q: Will the hair come back after laser?
faqs.a: Laser gives long-term hair reduction. After a full course, regrowth is sparse and fine, and hormonal areas may need occasional maintenance sessions to stay smooth.
